filmIntro.zh: 基于静态影像创作积累的审美，以及学生时期个人项目的实践经验，我逐步形成了对摄影语言的理解，能够结合导演的创作意图，灵活安排机位与摄像机运动。正在持续学习专业剧组的工作流程。
filmIntro.en: Drawing on the aesthetic sensibility developed through still photography and hands-on experience from personal projects as a student, I have developed an understanding of cinematographic language and can adapt camera placement and movement to the director’s creative vision. I continue to learn the workflows of professional film crews.

intro.zh:
我是墨岩，北京电影学院摄影专业2026级本科应届生，专注于静态影像与短片创作。

在静止的画面与流动的影像之间，我以摄影展开观察与表达。以下是我的部分摄影创作与短片项目。
intro.en:
I am Moyan, working across photography and cinematography.

Through still photographs and moving images, I observe and express. This is a collection of my art photography and short-film projects.

about.zh:
以摄影展开观察与表达。
在静止的画面与流动的影像之间，探索日常、空间与情绪。
about.en:
Through photography, I observe and express.
Working across still images and short films, I explore everyday life, space and emotion.

heading.zh:
静态影像。
电影摄影。

body.zh: 在专业学习、个人创作与剧组实践之间持续积累，逐步建立自己的电影摄影语言。
body.en: Continuing to learn through study, personal projects and on-set practice, towards a cinematographic language of my own.

text.zh: 影像创作者 / 北京清华附中分校摄影社创始人兼社长 / 北京电影学院 · 2026级摄影专业本科在读
text.en: Image maker / Undergraduate, Beijing Film Academy · Class of 2026

text.zh: 拥有多年静态影像创作经验，熟悉多种数码摄影设备及中画幅胶片摄影工艺，目前开展当代摄影与环境人像创作，并学习棚拍流程。
text.en: I have several years of experience in still photography and am proficient with a range of digital cameras and medium-format film photography techniques. My current practice focuses on contemporary photography and environmental portraiture, alongside learning studio photography workflows.

text.zh: 熟练掌握 Final Cut Pro，可独立完成短片剪辑，正在学习 DaVinci Resolve。善于结合导演的创作意图与影片节奏选取配乐，增强情绪与艺术表现力。
text.en: Proficient in Final Cut Pro, I can independently edit short films and am currently learning DaVinci Resolve. I select music to support the director’s creative vision and the film’s rhythm, strengthening its emotional and artistic impact.

text.zh: 更关注 AI 对传统影视流程的辅助，而非直接生成虚构影像；熟练运用 ChatGPT 辅助剧本拆解、分镜整理与制作流程表格，提高创作效率。
text.en: I focus on using AI to support traditional filmmaking workflows rather than generate fabricated imagery. I use ChatGPT to assist with script breakdowns, shot planning and production documentation, improving creative efficiency.

text.zh: MBTI为ENFJ，重视计划，擅长表达与现场沟通协调，可参与剧组管理、计划安排及信息传递。目前持续跟组学习，将影像感知与沟通能力转化为实际创作贡献；希望通过学习与实践，承担摄影助理、跟焦、灯光助理、录音助理及副导演相关工作。
text.en: As an ENFJ, I value planning, clear communication and on-set coordination, and can contribute to production organisation, scheduling and information flow. Through ongoing on-set learning, I am translating my visual awareness and communication skills into practical contributions. I hope to develop towards roles in camera assistance, focus pulling, lighting assistance, sound assistance and assistant directing.

text.zh: 具备剧本创作能力，目前持续进行剧本写作。
text.en: I also have screenwriting experience and continue to develop original scripts.

body.zh: 从纪实到当代摄影，在真实生活与空间中寻找情绪与叙事的线索。
body.en: From documentary to contemporary photography, finding traces of emotion and narrative in everyday life and space.

body.zh: 在短片创作中探索摄影、剪辑与配乐之间的关系，让影像组织故事与感受。
body.en: Exploring the relationship between cinematography, editing and music in short films, shaping stories and feelings through images.

body.zh: 围绕纪实、当代与情绪、人像等方向持续拍摄，以系列组织观察与表达。
body.en: Ongoing work in documentary, contemporary photography and portraiture, developing observations into photographic series.

body.zh: 在部分学生剧组作业中承担摄影、剪辑与配乐选取等工作，参与从现场画面到成片节奏的组织。
body.en: On student film projects, I have taken on cinematography, editing and music selection, helping shape the work from on-set images to the rhythm of the finished film.

title.zh: 剧组现场 · 持续学习

body.zh: 持续跟组学习，协助器材与现场信息传递，积累专业剧组的协作经验。
body.en: I continue to learn on set, assisting with equipment and communication while gaining experience working with professional film crews.

cooperationLead.zh:
摄影与短片，
一起学习，共同创作。

body.zh: 环境人像摄影、氛围感胶片人像、环境人像与棚拍人像
body.en: Photographic projects, short-film image-making and cinematography.

body.zh: 短片剪辑、叙事节奏与配乐选取。
body.en: Short-film editing, narrative rhythm and music selection.

title.zh: 摄影助理 / 灯光助理 / 焦点 /  现场协助

body.zh: 参与剧组现场工作，在明确职责的基础上协作与实践。
body.en: Contributing to productions through clearly defined support roles and practical collaboration.
